titulo: The first TV remote turned the knob

frases.texto: The first TV remote turned the channel knob from the sofa.
A motor inside the TV cranked it through a wire.
One button turned it up. The other turned it back.
It could turn the set off, too.
That wire ran across the rug, and people tripped over it.
It blinks a light your eyes can't see.
The TV reads that light and jumps to the channel.
Your phone can jump the channel too.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still gets up to change the channel.
